collection: Published bacterial/archaeal cases examined for structural evidence in functional annotation
scope: Primary-backed means at least the relevant primary abstract was examined, not that every function is confirmed or every full paper read. Verification scope is stated per case. Seven cases have principally primary abstract/summary coverage; remaining cases include relevant indexed or directly opened primary passages, with varying methods coverage.
limits: Published answers were known during retrospective investigation.
No new docking, structure alignment, crystallography, annotation run or biochemical/cellular experiments were performed.
PDBe contact annotations are existing software-derived records; no independent atom-distance or hydrogen-bond calculation was performed.
Modeled explanations are labeled separately from experimental observations.
No repository/design/document changes were made; only research data were written under this temporary directory.
data_validation: JSONL parses; 23 unique case IDs; all nine requested fields present.
